How does the free plan work? Can I try ConvertFlow before paying?

How does traffic billing work?
Your ConvertFlow plan's rate depends on traffic to your funnel campaigns powered by ConvertFlow.
For example, if your website gets 100,000 monthly unique visitors, but only 30,000 visitors see your popup, you'll only be billed for those 30,000 views.

What happens if I go over my paid plan’s funnel traffic limit?
You'll be notified via email as your account reaches 100% funnel traffic usage for the month.

When your account is subscribed to an annual plan, funnel traffic usage is billed monthly. This allows for increasing your funnel traffic limit beyond the annual plan's included limit. It also allows for adjusting your traffic limit mid-year.

What if I need more website sub-accounts?

Each "website" has its own funnel campaigns, tracking script, integrations, contacts, and its own pricing plan.
